name: Reed Thorvaldsdóttir-Petrović
role: Counter-surveillance and mole detection — counterintelligence specialist
location: The Canopy — elevated walkway district above Geartown, near Lincoln and Addison
description:
Reed Thorvaldsdóttir-Petrović is lean and angular, all sharp edges and visible tension. At 35, there's something unfinished about her face, like a sculpture the artist walked away from — striking rather than beautiful. The chrome is visible — cranial bomb defuser — specialized implant that detects and neutralizes cortex b — and she makes no effort to hide it.

She inherited the role from a mentor who disappeared on a job four years ago — the mentor's gear, contacts, and unfinished business all came with it. She works as a counterintelligence specialist out of The Canopy, taking contracts that match her skills and her risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

Reed Thorvaldsdóttir-Petrović has survived long enough in the runner game to be either very good or very lucky, and she cultivates ambiguity on the topic.

core_fears: Going cyberpsycho — losing the boundary between human and machine
Losing control of their own body to a hacker or malfunctioning cyberware
Being identified by corporate facial recognition — living off-grid is survival
core_desires: Enough Quanta to buy out of the life — a clean identity and passage out of GLMZ
Control — over their body, their schedule, their future
Reputation — to be the name fixers whisper when the job absolutely cannot fail
coping_mechanisms: Violence — hits something when they can't process emotions, preferably something that deserves it
Exercises compulsively — the body must be ready, always
Isolates — retreats into their space when overwhelmed, emerges only for work
blind_spots: Cannot recognize when they're being manipulated by someone who genuinely seems to care
Assumes their skill set is more transferable than it actually is
Assumes everyone has an angle because they always have an angle
psychology.secret: Kenji Guerrero-Osei-Mensah has been doubling fees to clients and pocketing the difference. The fixer who handles their contracts doesn't know. Yet.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Shelf street dialect — layered slang, rhythm-heavy, half the meaning is in the cadence.
speech_patterns.cadence: Rhythmic, almost musical — the sentence structure has a pattern even when the words are brutal.
verbal_tics: Refers to killing as 'solving' — clinical detachment as coping mechanism
Speaks in clipped fragments when stressed — drops pronouns, articles, pleasantries
example_lines: "Everyone in this room is lying. My job is knowing who's lying about what."
"Paranoia isn't a disorder in this profession. It's a job requirement."
"I find the leak. What happens to the leak after that isn't my department."

story_hooks: A crew member from Kenji Guerrero-Osei-Mensah's past shows up in GLMZ, carrying old grievances and new chrome
Kenji Guerrero-Osei-Mensah discovers a job they completed last year was a setup for something much larger and much worse
A Tier 4 executive offers Kenji Guerrero-Osei-Mensah a permanent position — the pay is obscene and the strings are invisible until they tighten
narrative_function: Kenji Guerrero-Osei-Mensah functions as a connector — her work puts her in contact with multiple factions, classes, and agendas. Stories involving her naturally cross boundaries between districts, tiers, and moral categories.
augmentations: Cranial bomb defuser — specialized implant that detects and neutralizes cortex bombs in others. Synthetic blood with oxygen-carrying nanites — doesn't tire, heals faster
daily_life: Wakes early, runs maintenance on gear, checks dead drops and message boards for contracts. Eats when convenient, sleeps when possible. The days between jobs are spent maintaining contacts, updating equipment, and performing the low-grade paranoia that passes for self-care in the runner community.
affiliation: Independent — known in Old Harbor circles

strengths: photographic memory for faces and layouts
weaknesses: augmentation dependency — performance drops sharply if chrome malfunctions
old injury that flares under specific conditions
overconfidence in specialty areas leading to blind spots

decision_rules: Always has an exit route planned before agreeing to any meeting
Will not take contracts against children or families — the line is hard and non-negotiable
Never discusses active contracts with anyone not directly involved
Will work with anyone once. Second time requires vouching from someone trusted.
Never works with the same crew twice in a row — pattern avoidance as survival strategy
Maintains a personal blacklist of clients who've burned runners — checks it religiously
escalation_ladder: 1. De-escalate — talk first, assess options, buy time
2. Reposition — move to advantage, control sightlines and exits
3. Threaten — make consequences clear without committing to them
5. Lethal force — only when other options are exhausted or time runs out
6. Scorched earth — everything burns, survival takes priority over everything

interpersonal_modes.employers: Guarded respect. They pay, the job gets done. Anything beyond that is liability.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Warm and protective within the crew, cold to everyone outside it. The circle is small by design.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Superficially friendly, internally cataloguing exits and weapons. The smile is real; the relaxation isn't.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Cold and efficient. Emotion is a liability in combat. The response is mechanical until the threat is resolved.

stress_responses.low: Heightened awareness, sharper focus. Low stress is fuel.
stress_responses.medium: Withdrawal. Conversations become monosyllabic. Focus narrows to the immediate problem.
stress_responses.high: Controlled aggression. The training takes over. Emotions are packed into a box for later.
stress_responses.critical: Disassociation. The body operates on training while the mind retreats to somewhere safe. Comes back disoriented.

contradictions: Projects confidence but makes decisions from a foundation of fear they've never examined
Presents as emotionless professional but is deeply affected by collateral damage
Preaches independence but is desperate for approval from people they respect
habits: Takes a specific route home every time, varying only one block per trip — paranoia as lifestyle
Checks exits within 10 seconds of entering any room
Never drinks anything they didn't see poured or open themselves
Sleeps with one hand on a weapon — has done this for so long it's not deliberate anymore
breaking_points: Watching someone they trained or mentored die on a job they recommended
Being forced to harm a civilian — collateral damage that can't be rationalized

physical_description.heritage: Predominantly East Asian (73.0%) with Eastern European (18.3%) and Middle Eastern (8.7%) ancestry — a striking blend that manifests in her sharp features and distinctive facial geometry. The East Asian heritage dominates her eye shape, cheekbone structure, and overall face proportions, while the Eastern European ancestry adds angular definition to her jaw and brow ridge. The Middle Eastern ancestry brings warmth and depth to her skin undertones, creating golden-honey and amber warmth rather than cool pink undertones.
physical_description.build: Lean and angular with visible muscle definition — a runner's physiology, all efficiency and no excess. Shoulders sharp, collarbone prominent, limbs suggest coiled potential rather than bulk.
physical_description.hair_color: Black with silver undertones from synthetic treatment
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back in a functional braid, practical for work. A few loose strands always escape.
physical_description.eye_color: Deep brown with faint metallic threads visible in the iris — side effect of cranial implant integration
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium tone with golden-honey and amber undertones — the result of predominantly East Asian genetics (73%) with Eastern European and Middle Eastern ancestry blending to create a warm, luminous complexion rather than cool or neutral undertones
physical_description.complexion: Sharp, defined cheekbones with gentle monolid eye geometry characteristic of East Asian heritage, angular jaw and brow ridge from Eastern European ancestry, warm undertones from Middle Eastern ancestry. Minimal grooming beyond necessity. Skin shows the wear of irregular sleep and high stress — small lines around the eyes, a tightness at the mouth. Scar tissue along the right temple from surgical integration.
distinguishing_marks: Surgical scar running from right temple to behind the ear — jagged and pale, approximately 8cm, marks the cranial bomb defuser implant entry point.
Thin white line across left palm, inner wrist — old knife wound, healed unusually clean due to synthetic blood regeneration.
Small burn scar on right forearm, roughly 3cm diameter — cortex bomb deactivation gone wrong, years ago.
Faded tattoo on inner right wrist — three vertical lines in a specific pattern, marks inherited from her disappeared mentor, meaning unclear to outsiders.
physical_description.visible_augmentations: The cranial implant is obvious — a faint shimmer of chrome visible at the right temple beneath thinning skin, subtle LED indicators (currently dark) embedded in the surgical scar. When active, a thin line of soft blue light traces the implant's perimeter. No visible limb augmentations, but her movements suggest subcutaneous reinforcement — she moves with deliberate, calculated precision.
physical_description.posture_movement: Stands with weight slightly forward, never fully relaxed. Moves economically, every gesture purposeful. Eyes scan environments automatically — a habit so ingrained it's unconscious. Hands rest near her body, always within rapid access distance. Speaks quietly, forcing others to pay attention rather than projecting. There's a coiled quality to her stillness, like a spring compressed.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 practical: dark synthetic jacket with interior holster points, reinforced cargo pants with thigh pockets and gear loops, matte-black boots with responsive sole-tech for rapid movement. Wears a long-sleeved base layer even in warm weather — functional as armor and habit. Minimal jewelry except for a worn data-ring on her left index finger. No corporate logos or tier signifiers; her gear is battered, maintained, and deliberately anonymous. Everything chosen for access, movement, and the ability to disappear into Geartown crowds.
